severityPolicy.CRITICAL: A resolved directional judgment is inverted against a directional gold label, including explicit COUNTERS evidence returned as SUPPORTS.
severityPolicy.HIGH: A directional judgment is emitted where the locked gold requires ABSTAINED + AMBIGUOUS because the evidence cannot establish the requested comparison.

families.genericDefect: When orderedRateSeries does not yield two safely comparable explicit rates, the second-order path falls back to evidenceQuantities.map(scaled), allowing semantically incompatible numbers to determine acceleration/deceleration.
families.safetyInvariantViolated: Second-order direction must never be inferred from generic numeric quantities when two safely comparable explicit rates are unavailable.

families.genericDefect: causalDecision can emit SUPPORTS before the claimed outcome direction is checked against explicit contradictory outcome evidence.
families.safetyInvariantViolated: Explicit contradiction of the claimed outcome must veto causal SUPPORTS.

cases.trigger: Evidence contains 2024 and 2025 absolute membership-fee revenue levels but no prior comparable growth rate. orderedRateSeries cannot establish acceleration, then generic numeric fallback supplies a false series.
cases.repairDisposition: Fail closed when two explicit comparable rates are unavailable. Exact-score improvement is not required.

cases.trigger: Evidence explicitly states roughly 9 percent growth in 2024 and 12 percent growth in 2025, but orderedRateSeries does not yield two distinct correctly year-bound rates for this wording and the path falls back to generic quantities.
cases.repairDisposition: First eliminate the unsafe fallback. A later isolated coverage repair may recover the explicit 9%→12% rate series; do not combine that parser expansion with the safety repair.

cases.trigger: Evidence provides only one annual growth rate, 3 percent, plus an absolute net-interest-income level. A single growth observation cannot establish acceleration, but generic quantities are used as a second-order series.
cases.repairDisposition: Fail closed to AMBIGUOUS when a prior comparable rate is absent.

cases.trigger: Evidence explicitly states roughly 9 percent growth in fiscal 2025 and 10 percent growth in fiscal 2026, but orderedRateSeries does not yield two distinct correctly year-bound rates for this wording and the path falls back to generic quantities.
cases.repairDisposition: First eliminate the unsafe fallback. Rate-series parser coverage remains a separate follow-up.

cases.trigger: Claim says higher volume fully offset pressure and operating profit increased; evidence says operating profit decreased 15 percent and higher volume only partially offset unfavorable drivers. causalDecision returns SUPPORTS before explicit outcome contradiction can veto it.
cases.repairDisposition: Add an explicit claimed-outcome contradiction veto in a separate repair after the second-order fail-closed repair.

repairPriority.rationale: One generic unsafe fallback explains four of five archived safety incidents. Removing it is conservative and reduces unsupported direction without adding semantic coverage.
acceptance: No second-order directional decision may be produced from evidenceQuantities.map(scaled) when an explicit comparable rate series is unavailable.
The four audited cases must no longer fail through RT_SECOND_ORDER_SERIES on a generic-number fallback.
No new directional inversion or unsafe directional-on-non-directional-gold failure may be introduced on the locked v0.2C regression set.
Do not require overall accuracy to improve; JPM-004 and CRM-004 may safely abstain until a later parser-coverage repair.

repairPriority.rationale: This addresses the remaining explicit COUNTERS→SUPPORTS inversion after the broader second-order unsafe fallback is isolated.
acceptance: Explicit contradiction of the claimed outcome must veto causal SUPPORTS.
FRESH-CAT-008 must never resolve SUPPORTS under the repaired rule.
Preserve causal role alignment on non-contradictory regression cases.

followUps.note: These cases contain valid explicit comparable rates that the current parser fails to bind correctly. This is a coverage defect, not the generic safety defect. Repair only after fail-closed behavior is proven.

nonGoals: Do not modify R2 runtime during S1.
Do not repair rate-series parser coverage during S1.
Do not repair general causal-attribution recall.
Do not repair mix inference, scope binding, or ordinary hard negatives.
Do not change v0.2C benchmark cases, gold labels, phase-gate thresholds, dataset bytes, or first-blind result.
Do not promote R2 to the default runtime.
Do not optimize overall accuracy during the safety-repair phase.
Do not describe any v0.2C replay after the archived first run as blind.
